title: 10 Roles and 3 Skills of a Manager | Principles of Management Ep 6
description:
Is a manager just someone who gives orders? In this animated lesson we follow Ravi through one busy day at his chai stall, Chai Corner, and discover that a manager plays many different roles and needs a special mix of skills.

You will learn Henry Mintzberg's 10 managerial roles from The Nature of Managerial Work (1973), sorted into three groups: interpersonal (figurehead, leader, liaison), informational (monitor, disseminator, spokesperson) and decisional (entrepreneur, disturbance handler, resource allocator, negotiator). Then we cover Robert Katz's three managerial skills from the Harvard Business Review (1955): technical, human and conceptual, and how the mix changes from lower level to top level managers.

This is Episode 6 of our Principles of Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.
